use_when: at the top of every dashboard page, to the right of the Sidebar.
Change the breadcrumb to match the page, such as Blind date with a book / Matches.
Keep search on so staff can find orders, readers or books from any page.

dont_use_when.when: on the reader website or app.
for page actions such as Add book.
dont_use_when.use_instead: put those under the page title

dont_use_when.when: Do not show more than 4 breadcrumb levels.

best_practice: Use the same top bar on every page so it feels familiar.
Write the search placeholder as what staff can find.
Use Avatar size 32 here and 40 in the Sidebar.

variant_intent.showSearch=true: Figma: keep search on so staff can find orders, readers or books from any page.

placement: The Top Bar spans the content area to the right of the Sidebar: breadcrumb on the left, search and avatar on the right. Page content starts below it.

a11y.fact: The breadcrumb inside is a <nav> landmark named "Breadcrumb" by default.
